scripts.build:unprotected: yarn clean && node ./scripts/fetch-market-home-token-seed.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production rspack build --config-loader jiti && cp ./web-build/index.html ./web-build/404.html && bash ./postbuild.sh
scripts.stats: cross-env NODE_ENV=production RSPACK_FULL_STATS=1 rspack build --config-loader jiti --json=web-build/stats.json
scripts.build:lavamoat: yarn clean && node ./scripts/fetch-market-home-token-seed.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=production SENTRY_UPLOAD_BY_CLI=true ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT=1 ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT_GENERATE_POLICY=0 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=10240 webpack build -c ./webpack.config.kill-switch.js && cp ./web-build/index.html ./web-build/404.html && bash ./postbuild.sh
scripts.lavamoat:policy: cross-env NODE_ENV=production ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT=1 ONEKEY_LAVAMOAT_GENERATE_POLICY=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=10240 webpack build -c ./webpack.config.kill-switch.js
